SHORT DESCRIPTION (80 max) — 77 used.
Where it actually earns its keep: the line under your name in search results. It leads with the hook, not the category — every competitor is a tracker, none of them let you play. "Track" still catches the search intent.

APP NAME (30 max) — 29 used.
"Satellite Tracker" stays intact as an exact substring — that is the phrase people search. "3D" is the differentiator, pointing at the thing worth choosing this app for.

FULL DESCRIPTION (4000 max) — 2,614 used.
PLAY WITH SATELLITES now leads, because Play truncates behind "read more" and the selling point has to sit above that fold.
